An interface to the Integrated Taxonomic Information System (ITIS)

- ITIS API Docs: <https://www.itis.gov/ws_description.html>
- Solr service: <https://www.itis.gov/solr_documentation.html>
- taxize book: <https://taxize.dev/>
- ritis docs: <https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/>

How to cite ITIS. From <https://itis.gov/citation.html>

To cite data obtained from ITIS, the following citation format is
offered as a suggestion:

``` R
Retrieved [month, day, year], from the Integrated Taxonomic Information System on-line database, http://www.itis.gov.
```

ITIS is one of many different taxonomic data sources. Other include:
Catalogue of Life (and COL+), NCBI taxonomy, International Plant Names
Index, Index Fungorum, and more. The Wikipedia entry
(<https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Integrated_Taxonomic_Information_System>)
states that ITIS has a North American focus, but includes many taxa not
in North America.

## Terminology

- “mononomial”: a taxonomic name with one part, e.g, *Poa*
- “binomial”: a taxonomic name with two parts, e.g, *Poa annua*
- “trinomial”: a taxonomic name with three parts, e.g, *Poa annua annua*

## Installation

Stable, CRAN version

``` r

install.packages("ritis")
```

Dev version

``` r

remotes::install_github("ropensci/ritis")
```

``` r

library("ritis")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`accepted_names()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/accepted_names.md)
  : Get accepted names from tsn
- [`any_match_count()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/any_match_count.md)
  : Get any match count.
- [`comment_detail()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/comment_detail.md)
  : Get comment detail from TSN
- [`common_names()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/common_names.md)
  : Get common names from tsn
- [`core_metadata()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/core_metadata.md)
  : Get core metadata from tsn
- [`coverage()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/coverage.md)
  : Get coverge from tsn
- [`credibility_rating()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/credibility.md)
  [`credibility_ratings()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/credibility.md)
  : Get credibility rating from tsn
- [`currency()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/currency.md)
  : Get currency from tsn
- [`date_data()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/date_data.md)
  : Get date data from tsn
- [`description()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/description.md)
  : Get description of the ITIS service
- [`experts()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/experts.md) :
  Get expert information for the TSN.
- [`full_record()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/full_record.md)
  : Get full record from TSN or lsid
- [`geographic_divisions()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/geographic_divisions.md)
  : Get geographic divisions from tsn
- [`geographic_values()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/geographic_values.md)
  : Get all possible geographic values
- [`global_species_completeness()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/global_species_completeness.md)
  : Get global species completeness from tsn
- [`hierarchy_down()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/hierarchy.md)
  [`hierarchy_up()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/hierarchy.md)
  [`hierarchy_full()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/hierarchy.md)
  : Get hierarchy down from tsn
- [`itis_facet()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/itis_facet.md)
  : ITIS Solr facet
- [`itis_group()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/itis_group.md)
  : ITIS Solr group search
- [`itis_highlight()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/itis_highlight.md)
  : ITIS Solr highlight
- [`itis_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/itis_search.md)
  : ITIS Solr search
- [`jurisdictional_origin()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/jurisdiction.md)
  [`jurisdiction_origin_values()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/jurisdiction.md)
  [`jurisdiction_values()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/jurisdiction.md)
  : Get jurisdictional origin from tsn
- [`kingdom_name()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/kingdoms.md)
  [`kingdom_names()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/kingdoms.md)
  : Get kingdom names from tsn
- [`last_change_date()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/last_change_date.md)
  : Provides the date the ITIS database was last updated
- [`lsid2tsn()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/lsid2tsn.md)
  : Gets the TSN corresponding to the LSID, or an empty result if there
  is no match.
- [`other_sources()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/other_sources.md)
  : Returns a list of the other sources used for the TSN.
- [`parent_tsn()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/parent_tsn.md)
  : Returns the parent TSN for the entered TSN.
- [`publications()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/publications.md)
  : Returns a list of the pulications used for the TSN.
- [`rank_name()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/rank_name.md)
  : Returns the kingdom and rank information for the TSN.
- [`rank_names()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/rank_names.md)
  : Provides a list of all the unique rank names contained in the
  database and their kingdom and rank ID values.
- [`record()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/record.md) :
  Gets a record from an LSID
- [`review_year()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/review_year.md)
  : Returns the review year for the TSN.
- [`ritis-package`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/ritis-package.md)
  [`ritis`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/ritis-package.md)
  : ritis
- [`scientific_name()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/scientific_name.md)
  : Returns the scientific name for the TSN. Also returns the component
  parts (names and indicators) of the scientific name.
- [`search_any_match_paged()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/search_any_match_paged.md)
  : Search for any matched page
- [`search_anymatch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/search_anymatch.md)
  : Search for any match
- [`search_common()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/search_common.md)
  : Search for tsn by common name
- [`search_scientific()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/search_scientific.md)
  : Search by scientific name
- [`solr`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/solr.md) : ITIS
  Solr Methods
- [`solr_fields`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/solr_fields.md)
  : List of fields that can be used in solr functions
- [`synonym_names()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/synonym_names.md)
  : Returns a list of the synonyms (if any) for the TSN.
- [`taxon_authorship()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/taxon_authorship.md)
  : Returns the author information for the TSN.
- [`terms()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/terms.md) : Get
  ITIS terms, i.e., tsn's, authors, common names, and scientific names
- [`tsn2lsid()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/tsn2lsid.md)
  : Gets the unique LSID for the TSN, or an empty result if there is no
  match.
- [`tsn_by_vernacular_language()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/tsn_by_vernacular_language.md)
  : Get tsn by vernacular language
- [`unacceptability_reason()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/unacceptability_reason.md)
  : Returns the unacceptability reason, if any, for the TSN.
- [`usage()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/usage.md) :
  Returns the usage information for the TSN.
- [`vernacular_languages()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ritis/reference/vernacular_languages.md)
  : Provides a list of the unique languages used in the vernacular
  table.
